title: Sonnets from the Portuguese
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning
description: "Sonnets from the Portuguese" by Elizabeth Barrett Browning is a collection of 44 love sonnets written around 1845–1846 and published in 1850.
longDescription: Despite the title, these deeply personal poems are Browning's own work, not translations.

authorInfo.bio: Elizabeth Barrett Browning (1806–1861) wrote Aurora Leigh. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
